parameters.query:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS day_start,
    (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS day_end
), mails AS (
  SELECT * FROM mail_logs WHERE received_at >= (SELECT day_start FROM bounds) AND received_at < (SELECT day_end FROM bounds)
)
SELECT
  count(*)::int AS total_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'High')::int AS high_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority <> 'High' OR priority IS NULL)::int AS normal_count,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE processed_status = 'failed')::int AS error_count,
  coalesce((SELECT count(*)::int FROM calendar_logs c JOIN mails m ON m.id = c.mail_log_id WHERE c.status = 'created'), 0) AS calendar_created_count,
  coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('subject', subject, 'summary', summary, 'priority', priority) ORDER BY received_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'High'), '[]'::json) AS high_items
FROM mails;
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_logs WHERE digest_date = $1::date AND channel = 'line' AND status = 'sent') AS already_sent;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO notification_logs (digest_date, channel, status, message, sent_at)
VALUES ($1::date, 'line', 'sent', $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (channel, digest_date) WHERE channel = 'line' AND status = 'sent' AND digest_date IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, status, sent_at;
